As part of the collaboration, TCS will help Indian Bank modernize its overseas treasury operations across money markets, investment management, and foreign exchange. The transformation will enable Indian Bank’s Colombo branch to move to a single, integrated treasury platform that supports unified deal processing, real-time position visibility, stronger risk and limit controls, and compliance-ready reporting. The Bank will be able to reduce manual intervention, improve straight-through processing, and strengthen audit and regulatory readiness through a single source of truth. The unit, with an initial capacity of 6 million cases per annum, marks a major milestone in ABD’s integrated manufacturing programme to serve the state’s growing spirits demand. The facility forms part of the assets acquired in January 2026 for ~ ₹70 crore and subsequently upgraded by ABD with an investment of ~ ₹40 crore. The commissioning enhances the Company’s bottling capacity in Uttar Pradesh and is expected to improve service efficiency while delivering cost benefits through increased in-house bottling and savings on franchise fees. Uttar Pradesh, one of India’s fastest-growing spirits markets, is central to ABD’s growth plans. The Company has announced an investment of over ₹600 crore in the state, including the acquisition and upgradation of the Moradabad unit and the development of an integrated facility comprising a dual-mode distillery and additional bottling capacity. Commenting on the development, Mr. Amar Sinha, Managing Director, ABD, said, “The commencement of operations at the Moradabad unit is an important step in strengthening ABD’s manufacturing base and presence in Uttar Pradesh.
